<div class="card-body">
'''Ubrikkian 9000 Z001''' is a [[Dark]] [[Vehicle]] ([[Transport]]) from [[Premiere (Japanese)|Premiere (Japanese)]].
<nowiki />
<h2>Title</h2>
<span lang="ja">ユブリッキアン9000 Z001</span>
<h2>Card Text</h2>
<span lang="ja">３名までの乗客を乗せられる。また、移動範囲内であれば、戦闘およびフォース消耗に対するリアクションとして移動を行うことができる。</span><ref name="jp-face">[[:File:Japanese-Premiere-1301-310o-SWCA.jpg|Original Japanese printed face]].</ref>
<h2>Lore</h2>
''<span lang="ja">密閉型の反重力ランドスピーダー。球状の外殻にマイクロ・スラスターが配置されている。３人乗りで、機動力が高い。最高時速は１６０キロ。</span>''<ref name="jp-face" />
<h2>Translation of Japanese Text</h2>
'''Title:''' Ubrikkian 9000 Z001.

'''Card text:''' May carry up to three passengers. May move within range as a react to a battle or Force drain.

'''Lore:''' An enclosed antigravity landspeeder with microthrusters mounted on its spherical shell. It seats three, maneuvers well, and reaches 160 kilometers per hour.

'''Comparison with the English printing:''' The English may move as a react only to a battle or Force drain; the Japanese omits only.
<h2>Notes</h2>
Japanese-language printing of [[Ubrikkian 9000 Z001]] in [[Premiere (Japanese)]].<ref name="encyc">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf SWCCG Collecting Encyclopedia 3.2], pp. 41, 100. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261008192828/https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/Star_Wars_CCG_Collecting_Encyclopedia_3.2.pdf Internet Archive].</ref><ref name="jp-face" />
